## Research or engineering change

Describe the problem, method, and affected components.

## Validation

- [ ] I recorded the commit, environment, configuration, and random seeds.
- [ ] I added or updated relevant tests.
- [ ] Performance claims follow `BENCHMARKS.md` and `REPRODUCIBILITY.md`.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, private game data, production logs, or unlicensed assets.
- [ ] I documented limitations and regressions.
- [ ] Material README changes are synchronized across language versions.
